paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 62b; Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Ulla.[^1]

notes.text: The stored Davidson Shabbat 62b scalar has Rava son of Rav Ilai. The alternative Rav Ulla is Hyman’s report of Dikdukei Soferim, whose apparatus has not been independently checked here. Both full Rav titles and the alternative reading remain; the named digital witness is not printed verification.
